purpose: Validate whether chronology-safe NSE shareholding XBRL category contexts map unambiguously to the approved MF holding, FII holding and institutional breadth concepts before any numerical history or future outcome is loaded.
aggregate_context_rule: Target category member must be present on CategoryOfShareholdersAxis and the context must contain no typedMember detail dimension. Multiple incompatible facts fail closed.
decision_rule: A mapping may proceed only if it is present and unambiguous in at least 8 of 10 parsed probe documents. If both FPI candidate members are viable, do not choose one post hoc; require a taxonomy-semantic rule that distinguishes aggregate versus detail context before numeric reconstruction.
